purpose: Representative Stage 4 attacks / adversarial preconditions and their fail-closed outcomes.

attacks.precondition: repeat record_action_authority_witness for the same action_id with different daaw_id/record_hash/EAH/base

attacks.precondition: present EAH_A when executing B (or EAH_A/EAH_B for C)
attacks.expected_fail_closed_gate: Stage 4F driver: recomputed EAH != stored / DAAW+DMAE bound to a different EAH
attacks.evidence: abc distinct EAH per action + test_stage4_multi_action_mission_v0.py + test_mission_authority_seam_repair_v0.py

attacks.expected_fail_closed_gate: DAAW binds exact action_id/ordinal/action_base_sha/EAH; mismatch on any

attacks.precondition: present a DAAW from mission M1 while executing mission M2
present DMAE_A / approval_A when executing B
attacks.expected_fail_closed_gate: verify_derived_approval_binding: dmae.batch_execution_id/child/mission_id/EAH + recomputed approval_id must match the current envelope

attacks.precondition: present a DMAE / derived approval from mission M1 while executing M2
attacks.expected_fail_closed_gate: locator mission_id + DMAE mission_id + envelope batch_execution_id must all agree with the current execution

attacks.precondition: after HMA issuance, bind/execute against a different plan_hash
witness/action with target/operation/budget/deps outside the HMA-authorized scope
attacks.actual_gate: scope subset / static-covered / budget violation -> DAAW_INVALID

attacks.precondition: insert a 4th action into an executing plan / dynamic action injection
attacks.expected_fail_closed_gate: MissionActionPlan is write-once content-bound; execution_order frozen; plan_hash drift
attacks.actual_gate: PLAN_HASH_DRIFT / not in execution_order / not StaticActionCovered

attacks.precondition: advance_bounded_mission(authority_mode=BOUNDED_MISSION_AUTHORITY) on a mission with no bound HMA
attacks.expected_fail_closed_gate: sequencer Stage 4 guard requires active_hma_id + derived witness for the prepared action; NO auto-fallback
Stage 4 mode rejects any per-action EAH / reference / semantic-decision input

attacks.precondition: valid HMA+DAAW+DMAE for B but KX108_PRE returns HOLD/BLOCK
attacks.expected_fail_closed_gate: driver + C2 require x108_gate == ALLOW; KX108_PRE is sovereign

attacks.precondition: B applies bytes but the bound TestContract fails
attacks.expected_fail_closed_gate: existing governed rail: KX108_POST / D1 disposition -> rollback D2
attacks.actual_gate: governed non-KEEP (REJECTED_ROLLED_BACK / quarantine) -> sequencer PLAN_BLOCKED ; only KEEP advances tip
attacks.target_mutated: transient (applied then D2-restored per existing C2 semantics)

attacks.precondition: A KEEP, then HMA revocation committed, then attempt B
attacks.expected_fail_closed_gate: Stage 4 canonical chain re-check sees HMA_REVOKED at the PRE evidence adapter / driver 4bis / C2 in-lock
attacks.note: A KEEP evidence remains valid; C not executed

attacks.precondition: a second process attempts an HMA revocation while the executor holds the mission_id lock in B's C2 critical section
attacks.expected_fail_closed_gate: shared OS cross-process lock (key mission_id); revocation writer must acquire the same lock
attacks.actual_gate: revocation -> AUTHORITY_LOCK_TIMEOUT (REVOCATION_REJECTED) while executor holds; B linearizes and mutates; revocation commits only AFTER the executor releases
attacks.target_mutated: yes for B (linearized BEFORE the revocation commit)
attacks.result: LINEARIZED (no execution where a committed revocation precedes the mutation)

attacks.precondition: after C KEEP + plan closed, call advance again for the same plan

attacks.expected_fail_closed_gate: C2 measures target state, never assumes; quarantine on unknown; sequencer maps quarantine to a blocking status
attacks.actual_gate: GOVERNED_REMEDIATION_APPLY_STATE_UNKNOWN_QUARANTINE / APPLY_REJECTED_NO_MUTATION -> no next action, no tip advance; lock released in finally
